newsitem.title: USA: Bonded Motors sees Q2 EPS $0.08-$0.10/shr.
newsitem.headline: Bonded Motors sees Q2 EPS $0.08-$0.10/shr.

text.p: Bonded Motors Inc, a remanufacturer of car and light-truck engines, Tuesday said it expects second quarter earnings between $0.08 and $0.10 a share versus $0.14 a share in 1996's second quarter.
Financial analysts had expected the company to earn $0.18 a share, according to First Call.

In a statement, the company said it had record second quarter revenues, but higher-than-normal costs. Moreover, a new production line has created unexpected bottlenecks and caused company workflow to be uneven.
"Overhead and distribution expenses exceeded our 24 percent quarterly revenue growth rate and impacted second quarter earnings," said Chief Executive Officer Aaron Landon.
Landon said changes in the manufacturing process have led to higher direct and indirect labor costs and higher-than-normal warranty expenses.
He said the company is working to address both revenue and cost issues. It plans to report full second quarter results after financial markets close on August 4.
